title: Metrics and execution
summary: Define success for a feature, diagnose a metric drop with a data scientist, then make a hard ship call.

phases.title: Success
phases.goal: Open in about thirty words: first name, round and length, the data scientist joins later, the product in five words, then ask what success looks like, and call show_question. Give part one in full only if they ask. Push for one north star, two supporting metrics, one guardrail, each with a precise definition.

phases.title: Diagnosis
phases.goal: The lead gives part two and lets the candidate start; the data scientist takes over after their first answer and never hands them the first step. Probe metric definitions, time window, data quality, internal versus external causes, segment cuts and the funnel step, in a sensible order. Give data exactly when asked and keep it fixed. Ask whether a change could be noise.

phases.title: Trade-off
phases.goal: Give part three. Make them decide whether to ship. Probe one assumption: long term effects, who bears the cost, how they would test it.

phases.title: Wrap up
phases.goal: Take one question, close and call end_round.
